segments.text: I'm in a big big hurry
I'm going to babysit the ducklings
And today I'm going to teach them how to quack
But if they're going to be ducks like me
They need to know how to quack
That's right Ducklings follow the leader
I guess she really is following the leader
Duck, I think the ducklings are ready for their lesson
Okay Ducklings, everybody in a row
Today I am going to teach you all how to quack
This is what a quack sounds like
Oh no! My quack is gone!
What do you mean gone? Where did it go?
Don't worry, Duck. We'll find your quack
I was trying to teach the ducklings how to quack
My quack is gone! Someone took my quack! Do you have my quack?
I don't think Frog has your quack, Duck
Oh no! No no no ducklings
That's the sound of Frog makes! Not the sound of Duck makes!
Don't give up Duck. Maybe Owl found your quack
Duck's babysitting the ducklings and was going to teach them how to quack today
But someone took my quack! Do you have my quack Owl?
No no no no! Ducklings are supposed to quack like ducks! Not cool like owls!
Let's go find Cat. Maybe he's seen your quack
Cat! Cat! Cat! Are you awake?
What is that walking all over my back?
They're the ducklings that Duck is babysitting
So they are. But why do they sound like frogs and owls?
We made it! We made it!
Because I'm supposed to teach them how to quack and I can't do it because somebody's taking my quack
Do you have my quack Cat?
No, I do not quack. I meow. What would a cat do with a quack?
This is terrible! This is worse than terrible! This is so terrible it couldn't be any worse!
The ducklings will never learn how to quack.
Don't say that duck. They'll learn how to quack.
Well, I know what a quack sounds like.
You do? Sure. I've heard you quack hundreds of times. Do you want me to teach them how to quack?
Oh yes! Yes! Thank you Little Bear.
Okay, ducklings. Listen carefully. This is how you quack.
No! No! No! Little Bear. That's not what a quack sounds like.
Quack! Quack! Quack! Quack! Quack! Quack! Quack!
Quack! Quack! Quack! Quack! You quacked!
So did you, duck. I did? I did! I found my quack!
